#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    vector<int> boundaries;
    boundaries.push_back(0);
    for (int i = 1; i < (int)s.length(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] != s[i-1]) {
            boundaries.push_back(i);
        }
    }
    boundaries.push_back((int)s.length());
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i + 1 < (int)boundaries.size(); ++i) {
        if (((boundaries[i+1] - boundaries[i]) & 1) == 0) {
            ++ans;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
